_comment: Facets are what makes one branch of a chain different from the next one. The category tree answers 'what kind of place is this'; facets answer 'is it worth walking to THAT one'. Order = display order, on the place page and in the filter-chip row. 'auto' names the importer rule that can fill it without asking a human — everything else waits for someone standing at the door. A facet with no evidence renders as nothing at all: absent is not the same as false, and a directory that guesses 'no ATM' is worse than one that says nothing.
_applies_note: appliesTo matches record.sub. Convenience stores first because that is where the question is loudest — 386 7-Elevens with identical records — but nothing here is 7-Eleven-specific and the same row will serve pharmacies and fuel stations when their turn comes.
